boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, map-documented study environments in the Anderson Academic Commons, with current library access and reservation guidance.

cards.title: Fogel Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, upper level
cards.notes: Set up in the named reading room, then use the nearby upper-level stacks to pull print sources before settling into a focused work block.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed upper-level reading room beside library collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Libraries' Anderson Academic Commons map labels the Fogel Reading Room on the upper level.
cards.source_title: Main Library at the Anderson Academic Commons
cards.access_notes: A valid DU ID is required to enter campus buildings, including the library.

cards.title: Gottesfeld Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, main level
cards.notes: Choose this named reading room when you want a library-based session with browsing periodicals and main-level services shown nearby on the building map.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed reading room near browsing periodicals.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Libraries' Anderson Academic Commons map labels the Gottesfeld Reading Room on the main level near Browsing Periodicals.
cards.source_title: Main Library at the Anderson Academic Commons
cards.access_notes: A valid DU ID is required to enter campus buildings, including the library.

cards.title: Quinette Family Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, main level
cards.notes: Use this named main-level reading room as a landing point for independent work, with the library classroom and special collections area mapped close by.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room on the main level of AAC.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Libraries' Anderson Academic Commons map labels the Quinette Family Reading Room on the main level.
cards.source_title: Main Library at the Anderson Academic Commons
cards.access_notes: A valid DU ID is required to enter campus buildings, including the library.

cards.title: Faculty Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, main level
cards.notes: Confirm that this room fits your access needs before heading over; the AAC map identifies it separately from public reading and group-study areas.
cards.short_summary: A separately labeled reading room in the Academic Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Libraries' Anderson Academic Commons map labels a Faculty Reading Room on the main level.
cards.source_title: Main Library at the Anderson Academic Commons
cards.access_notes: A valid DU ID is required to enter campus buildings, including the library; confirm room eligibility with University Libraries.

cards.title: Frank Study Area
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, main level
cards.notes: Head to this named study area for an individual work session, using the map to orient from the main-level stacks and nearby service spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named study area on AAC's main level.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Libraries' Anderson Academic Commons map labels the Frank Study Area on the main level.
cards.source_title: Main Library at the Anderson Academic Commons
cards.access_notes: A valid DU ID is required to enter campus buildings, including the library.

cards.title: The Loft
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, upper level
cards.notes: Use the AAC map to find The Loft on the upper level, then make it your base for reading or drafting between trips to the stacks.
cards.short_summary: A named upper-level study area in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Libraries' Anderson Academic Commons map labels The Loft on the upper level.
cards.source_title: Main Library at the Anderson Academic Commons
cards.access_notes: A valid DU ID is required to enter campus buildings, including the library.

cards.title: Viewing Area
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, main level
cards.notes: Bring course media or research viewing to this named area and pair it with notes or a laptop session in the surrounding main-level library spaces.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed media viewing area in AAC.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Libraries' Anderson Academic Commons map labels a Viewing Area on the main level.
cards.source_title: Main Library at the Anderson Academic Commons
cards.access_notes: A valid DU ID is required to enter campus buildings, including the library.

cards.title: Large Group Study Room 182
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, lower level
cards.notes: Coordinate a project group for this lower-level room; library guidance says lower-level study rooms are first-come, first-served, so have a backup plan.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed lower-level large group study room.
cards.evidence_claim: The AAC map identifies Room 182 as a lower-level Large Group Study Room, and University Libraries states lower-level study rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.access_notes: Lower-level study rooms are first-come, first-served. A valid DU ID is required to enter campus buildings, including the library.

cards.title: Small Group Study Room 108A
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, main level
cards.notes: Use this specific small group room for shared coursework; check the library's booking system if you need a reserved room rather than walk-in availability.
cards.short_summary: A specifically numbered small group room on AAC's main level.
cards.evidence_claim: The AAC map identifies Room 108A as a Main Level Small Group Study Room; University Libraries says non-lower-level study rooms can be reserved online.
cards.access_notes: Group rooms are for DU students, staff, and faculty doing academic work; reservations are limited to groups and may be made for up to four hours.

cards.title: Research Carrel Room
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, individual research space
cards.notes: Apply for a carrel only if you are actively working on an advanced DU research project and can secure advisor confirmation for the request.
cards.short_summary: A quiet individual-research room with carrels, tables, and armchairs.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries describes the Research Carrel Room as a quiet AAC space with individual carrels, lockers, community tables, and armchairs for advanced DU research projects.
cards.source_title: Research Carrels and Lockers | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Limited availability; application, advisor confirmation, and a library account in good standing are required. DU ID is required for building entry.
